title: Subspace Crystallization in Grokking: Rank Compression Tracks the Phase Transition
abstract: arXiv:2610.35112v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Grokking describes understanding something deeply and intuitively. In neural networks, it is the phenomenon where a network generalizes long after memorizing its training data. This delay has been linked to a fall in the effective rank of the network's weight matrices, but whether this rank compression drives grokking or follows it is still unresolved. We study a mean-field MLP and a one-layer transformer trained on modular arithmetic and observe that: (i) Compression follows the onset, not memorization. Every transformer memorizes its training data within 250 steps, while the grokking onset (the first step at which test accuracy reaches 95%) varies from 6,500 to 21,000 steps. The steepest fall in effective rank comes about 900 steps after the onset, however late the onset occurs, and networks that memorize without grokking compress far less. (ii) Subspace crystallization. translated_title: Grokking中的子空间结晶：秩压缩追踪相变
translated_abstract: Grokking描述的是对事物深刻而直观的理解。在神经网络中，它指的是网络在记住训练数据很久之后才实现泛化的现象。这种延迟已被与网络权重矩阵有效秩的下降联系起来，但这种秩压缩究竟是驱动grokking还是跟随grokking，仍是一个未解决的问题。我们研究了在模运算上训练的平均场MLP和单层Transformer，并观察到：(i) 压缩跟随泛化起始点而非记忆。每个Transformer都在250步内记住了其训练数据，而grokking起始点（测试准确率首次达到95%的步数）在6,500到21,000步之间变化。无论起始点出现得多晚，有效秩最陡峭的下降总是发生在起始点之后约900步，而那些只记忆却不发生grokking的网络，其压缩程度要小得多。(ii) 子空间结晶。我们将权重矩阵最少数量的顶部奇异方向所张成的空间称为……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文发现权重矩阵的有效秩压缩（“子空间结晶”）总是紧跟泛化起始点之后约900步出现，而非伴随记忆发生，且只记忆不泛化的网络压缩程度远小，从而表明秩压缩是追踪Grokking相变的结果而非记忆的产物。
en_tdlr: This paper finds that effective rank compression ("subspace crystallization") in weight matrices consistently trails the grokking onset by about 900 steps rather than coinciding with memorization, and is far weaker in memorizing-but-not-generalizing networks, showing that rank compression tracks the grokking phase transition rather than memorization.
